import pathlib
progdir=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            marked.add(row[0])
            for c in range(w):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        color = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)):
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
file=progdir/'task-75f3c448.py'
file.write_text(program)
print(file, file.exists())
